name: JG_FSCL_DOC_ASSET_CNTRLS_ALL_F
description: This table contains setup details relating to fixed asset transfer information, that requires generation of a fiscal document.

columns.name: FSCL_DOC_ASSET_CNTRL_ID
columns.description: Fixed assets transfer control setup identifier.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier used for creating the receivables invoice which supports fiscal document generation.

columns.name: FROM_LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Legal reporting unit identifier that is associated with the source location from where the asset is transferred.

columns.name: TO_LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Legal reporting unit identifier that is associated with the destination location where the asset is transferred to.

columns.name: BATCH_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Transaction Source name used for creating the receivables invoice.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Transaction type identifier used for creating receivables invoice.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Transaction type name used for creating receivables invoice.

columns.name: TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment term identifier. Use the Manage Receivables Payment Terms task to find valid values. Do not use for credit memos or on-account credits.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer account identifier used for creating the receivables invoice.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Bill to customer account number used for creating the receivables invoice.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer site identifier used for creating the receivables invoice.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Bill to customer site number used for creating the receivables invoice.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates validity of the records.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
